title: Workplace Safety Policy
description: Free Workplace Safety Policy template you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers policy statement, commitments, responsibilities.

Policy Statement

1. [Organisation] is committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace for all employees,

contractors, visitors and anyone affected by our activities.

2. We will comply with applicable health and safety laws and other requirements we subscribe

to, and continually improve our safety performance.

Commitments

1. Identify hazards, assess risks and apply the hierarchy of control: eliminate, substitute,

engineer, administer, then PPE.

2. Consult with workers and their representatives and encourage reporting of hazards, near

misses and incidents without blame.

3. Provide adequate resources, competent people, training, equipment and supervision.

4. Investigate incidents to find root causes and prevent recurrence.

5. Prepare for emergencies and test arrangements regularly.

6. Set measurable safety objectives and review them at least once a year.

Responsibilities

WhoResponsibility
Senior managementProvide leadership, resources and set objectives; review performance
Managers and supervisorsImplement this policy, supervise work, correct unsafe conditions
EmployeesFollow safe procedures, use PPE, report hazards and incidents, stop unsafe work
Contractors and visitorsFollow site rules and the instructions of the site contact
HSE functionAdvise, monitor, audit and report on safety performance

Communication

☐ Displayed at entrances and notice boards

☐ Included in induction and available to contractors on request

☐ Reviewed after major change or incident
